ali (Infra): Got it. Requested SNI/hosts and IP ranges? Any mTLS needs?

priya (Eng): We can carve region-scoped ACLs and schedule short rate windows. Suggest autoscaling QPS for the EU route during onboarding to 1,500 QPS for 6h with autorevoke. APAC pilot: 100 QPS, no SLA change.
noah (CS): Customer specifically asked for a "proof-of-path" screenshot + sample sanitized trace after canary. Also asked for confirmation of 30-day log retention; may request CMK later.
